findings.summary: Cart quantity changes did not announce the product context or updated order total.
findings.fix: Use the polite status region to announce the product name, new quantity, and cart total after quantity changes and removal.
findings.evidence: Quantity changes previously called finishPersistence without a message.

findings.summary: Removing the last cart item removed the focused button without moving focus to the empty state.
findings.fix: Move focus to the cart heading after the last row is removed and announce the updated cart total.
findings.evidence: The Remove button was removed from the DOM when the cart became empty.

passed: Persistence errors and route changes use existing status and focus handling.
Cart quantity and removal updates now announce the item context and updated total.
Removing the last product moves focus to the cart heading.
notes: Findings were recorded before their indicated fixes; the final implementation was verified afterward.
